final_topology.title: High Availability Branch Office
final_topology.description: A branch office network with emphasis on high availability and voice service continuity, connecting to the central data center and supporting SIP-based voice traffic.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a primary connection to the central data center and a failover mechanism for voice services to the public phone network. It supports SIP-based voice traffic and includes centralized user authentication and network traffic logging.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory Manager' node (n_new1) and a link (nl21) from the 'Asset Inventory Manager' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that asset inventory management is in place.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation' node (n_new3) and a link (nl_new5) from 'Data Flow Documentation' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that data flow documentation is in place.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones such as 'Security Zone', 'Management Zone', 'Non-Production Zone', and 'External Testing Zone', which suggests that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' node (n3) and a 'Security Services Security Gateway' node (n_struct1), both of which are firewalls, indicating that firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' node (n13) and a link (nl10) from the 'DNS Server' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Service' node (n25) and a link (nl22) from the 'MFA Service' to the 'Identity Server', indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' node (n14) and a link (nl11) from the 'DNS Filter' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' node (n15) and a link (nl12) from the 'Web Proxy' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and security nodes such as 'Firewall', 'NIDS', 'NIPS', and '802.1X Controller', indicating a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Bastion' node (n11) and links (nl7, nl8) from the 'Management Bastion' to the 'Central AAA Server' and 'Firewall', indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' node (n12) and links (nl7, nl9) from the 'Central AAA Server' to the 'Management Bastion' and 'Firewall', indicating that network AAA is centralized.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'Primary Link' and 'Failover Link' nodes (n9, n10) with links (nl2, nl4) to the 'Central Data Center Router' and 'Public Phone Network Gateway', indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' node (n21) in the 'Management Zone' and a link (nl18) from the 'Admin Workstation' to the 'Management Bastion', indicating that dedicated computing resources are established and maintained for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS' node (n16) and a link (nl13) from the 'NIDS' to the 'Firewall', indicating that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' node (n3) and multiple zones, indicating that traffic filtering between network segments is performed.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Manager' node (n26) and a link (nl23) from the 'Access Control Manager' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' node (n6) and a link (nl6) from the 'SIP Server' to the 'SIEM', indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIPS' node (n17) and a link (nl14) from the 'NIPS' to the 'Firewall', indicating that a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' node (n20) and a link (nl17) from the '802.1X Controller' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that port-level access control is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' node (n18) and a link (nl15) from the 'Application Firewall' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that application layer filtering is performed.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) and a link (nl19) from the 'Non-Production Server' to the 'Primary Router', indicating that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' node (n23) and a 'Pen Test Scheduler' node (n_new2) with links (nl20, nl_new2) to the 'Primary Router' and 'Pen Test Service', indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.
